reviews.text:
Valentina was awesome!!!
Great customer service with my hair trim and painless. She's always great every time I go for my trim.

This is a high-end salon where I get my men’s haircut with scissors. I was treated well during my recent visit. Alain, my barber, is experienced and professional. The haircut was detailed and met my expectations. Despite it being a busy Saturday, Alain managed to give me a great haircut. I highly recommend this salon. However, the pricing is high. $$$

Thank You Ivette, for taking the time and review our Salon Spa & Barbershop. We are proud of the service and dedication we do on every style performed. See you again soon at The Well Groomed Gentleman.
What are the best beard trims I’ve had in my life. The attention for detail was outstanding

I never like to leave bad reviews but this one is especially warranted. I tried this spot after my barbershop closed. Unfortunately, I got a bad haircut from Harlin. I told Harlin what I wanted, showed him a picture, and he didn’t follow instructions. He cut my hair too short and did an overall bad job. He did not check in with me until I told him this was not what I wanted and he should fix it in these ways.

He then tried tell me how I wear my hair and tried to dissuade me from fixing his mistakes so he could move onto his next appointment. The whole order took 70 mins - the longest haircut I have ever had.

Last, The Well Groomed Gentleman has no vibe or friendly atmosphere. It is just a modern soulless shop on Miracle Mile with a bunch of broken TVs and barbers on their phones.

I Do Not Recommend going here.
Best haircut experience I’ve had in miami. Julio was great!
John did an excellent job. He cut both my son and my hair. I, also, got a shave. Both haircuts looked great.
Javier did an amazing job.  I have tricky hair and he made it look just right.  Will definitely be back. Everyone in the store is super friendly and welcoming.
Always a great experience! Yoan is a master  hair stylist, who’s very good at what he does!
Very nice experience.
Silvina is outstanding and friendly...the facility is nice and a convenient location in Coral Gables for me!
Great experience!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

An excellent experience from beginning to end. Without a doubt, the best haircut I've ever had. Herlin truly exceeds expectations, and it's clear from the first moment that he has a real passion for his work. He not only pays attention to every detail but also takes the time to understand exactly what you're looking for and ensures the result is perfect.

His technique, precision, and dedication make a huge difference. I never felt rushed; on the contrary, he worked with great care and professionalism to ensure everything was impeccable. Plus, the atmosphere is very pleasant, and the customer service is excellent.

If you're looking for a barber who truly loves what he does and delivers top-quality work, Herlin is the best choice. I recommend him 100%, and I will definitely be back.
Very calm, professional, and enjoyable. Will definitely come again
Excellent service. I recommend Yoan because he adapts to the clients’ haircut preferences.

Need to give an update on this place. I have been here 2x now and each time was exceptionally terrible. I would be very careful. If you are getting a fade you will probably be fine - but anything with clippers is a disaster waiting to happen. Additionally, management offers a 10% discount on your NEXT visit if they mess you up....
Hair and beard trim were spot on and service was great
Excellent mani/pedi service!

These barbershops for me at least the one located in coral gables the customer service is super bad, I was a regular customer but after today I will never return
Probably the worst haircut i’ve ever experienced in my life and it was 60$ from the lady that works there. She had absolutely no idea what she was doing.

I've been getting my hair cut by Michael for several years. My son and I have been getting our hair cut by him for over eight years now. We're always very happy with the results. The service is always excellent. I highly recommend him!
Yoan is the best! 10/10 experience and definitely coming back.
For this visit, Ernesto was my barber.  He was excellent with the head shave and beard trim service I received.  Highly recommend him.
Xavier was great as always
A place where your dream comes true. I get my hair cut there by Juan Carlos, he's been my barber for over 10 years, and my son goes there too. I 100% recommend it, excellent vibes.
Good experience ! And really nice hairdresser.
Great service from Raudel.
Wonderful. I had a beard trim and shaping. My stylist was friendly, polite and gave me a great tidy up. Great value and great experience.

Terrible quality. It seems to be the worst haircut of my life.

I came in with washed hair, but I had some styling clay applied. I wasn’t even offered a hair wash first; the employee just proceeded as it was.

The areas around my ears and at the back weren’t faded at all. The hair on top looks like “steps.”

The scissors were barely used, and only on the top. There wasn’t even an attempt to properly blend or refine the sides. As a result, the contour is uneven.

For this price — $55 + a minimum 18% tip!? — it is too much. Sorry, never again.

The idea of a “barber shop” seems to have been lost somewhere in this place.

Went for years but once my hair got to shoulder length I was told to not come back because they don’t have the skill set to work long hair. Which honestly sucks because I was told that if your a man with shoulder length hair or longer this was not the place for me. I haven’t been back in over 4 years now as my hair is shoulder length and I don’t plan to have a fade anytime soon

I normally don’t write reviews but Raudel needs to be commended. I went in early as a walk-in as I was in need of a beard trim before an event. He fit me in for a trim, even though he had a busy calendar that day. He spent time talking to me about a Reuzel, didn’t try to sell me on it at all but totally would recommend smells amazing. Had my beard cleaned and he took it upon himself and cleaned up my neckline. Anyone looking for a good barber and a good person look for Raudel in WGG.
Raudel gave an excellent service and advice on styling. Great music and drinks on the house. 100% recommended.
Raudal gave me a great haircut!
Raudel is the best!

barber didn't listen. Took too much off. Won't be back. And $55 for trip is stupid.

I had an excellent experience with Julio M at Well Groomed Gentleman. I came in right before an important meeting in South Florida, and Julio absolutely delivered. The haircut was sharp, professional, and exactly what I needed to feel confident walking into that meeting.

What really stood out was the overall experience, the shop has a true spa-like atmosphere that makes you feel relaxed and taken care of from start to finish. It’s more than just a haircut, it’s an experience.

Highly recommend Julio if you’re looking for top-notch service and attention to detail. I’ll definitely be back.
Exceptional service.
As always their service is impecable.

“So you want me to just take off some of the extra hair?” Somehow, within 45 minutes or so, I had to process responding to this statement in a positive and uplifting manner; a baby crying and the mom fighting with someone was heard howling from the distance, a 10 yr old boy was completely ignored by a group of “men” while trying to be openly proud that he was getting cleaned up for his big day tomorrow; my request for no razor edge on my face was ignored (which means I get to then smell like gas station cologne from the junk THEY ALL use, which is why I ask for no razor) and I was reminded very quickly that I will be able to tip with my card upon checkout. I then went home and finished cutting my hair on my own with my long beard trimmer attachment to find an upsetting amount of uneven areas around the back of my head. $100 experience that I most certainly will not endeavor to have again.

Incredibly over priced for the service. Do not recommend. Save your money and go to one of the many talented barbers all around Miami.

Do not come here.
The service provided by Yohan was above the expectation  🙌🏽 I highly recomand this amazing place!

I've been a member ($60 a month) with Well-Groomed for over 5 years. The membership included monthly services that would accumulate over time if not used. Since I went once every few months, I always had services accumulated. I went in last week and when I went to give the tip only (since my service was covered under the membership), the gentleman told me my credits were gone and they had stopped the membership program a few months ago. I was furious, to say the least. No email, phone call, or text from this company advised that they were discontinuing the membership program. To add insult to injury, they were still advertising the membership program as late as September 2024.

I don't know if this place is still owned by the same gentleman who was a veteran of the armed forces (as I am) and had ethics and standards. If it is, shame on him. If it isn't, the new owner is obviously not customer service oriented and is only out to make a buck.
